content_sections.heading: About NUJS Programme Manager
content_sections.text: The West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences is a university in Kolkata. It runs a project supported by Azim Premji Philanthropic Initiatives Pvt. Ltd. under Azim Premji Foundation. The project aims to enhance access to justice by equipping young lawyers through fellowship, mentorship and litigation training, building a cadre of trained lawyers, and developing community paralegals to provide grassroots legal support to vulnerable communities in the Sundarbans region. The Programme Manager will be responsible for the overall implementation and monitoring of the project. The Programme Manager will work with the Faculty Project Coordinator towards achieving the project's objectives.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications, along with the required documents, must be sent by email to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Applications must reach the University by midnight on 30 November 2026. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. The notice does not give an application form or a subject line for the email. The application consists of the documents listed under Enclosures below.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Programme Manager. The post is full-time and contractual. The selected candidate will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs 75,000/- per month during the first year of engagement. This remuneration will be paid under the grant received by the University from the Azim Premji Foundation. Graduate with an LL.B. degree, including the recipient of a 5-Year integrated B.A/B.Sc./BB.A./B.Com LL.B. (Hons.) degree. Proficiency in English and Hindi/Bengali. Minimum five years of post-qualification experience including but not limited to litigation or conducting training programmes in law/policy/related domains or working for reputed national/international organisations. Candidates with an LL.M. degree/Post-graduate degree in subjects deemed relevant for the project will be preferred. Candidates with prior experience in working for projects/programmes run by the Government of India or the government of any state/union territory in India or reputed national or international organisations will be preferred. The above qualifications may be relaxed in exceptional circumstances by the University. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The period of engagement will be for one year. Any extension will be subject to the needs of the project and the availability of funds. The Programme Manager will be required to reside in Kolkata for the duration of the contract. The Programme Manager will be required to travel according to the needs of the project.

content_sections.heading: NUJS Programme Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives the following indicative list of responsibilities: Implementing the project design and advancing the overall project objectives. Implementing the public outreach frameworks to facilitate fulfilment of the project's various aims. Liaising with multiple relevant stakeholders to ensure effective project implementation. Ensuring and monitoring achievement of project outcome and targets. Establishing and implementing the review and assessment mechanisms required for the smooth functioning of the project. Coordinating between all project participants and ensuring compliance of all project activities according to the standards set by the university. Writing of regular project reports as required and coordinating with the Faculty Project Coordinator for update of progress, regular reviews, developing and implementing strategy according to the needs of the project. Any other work that may be necessary to realise and further the project objectives.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Updated resume. Statement of Purpose (not exceeding 500 words), outlining the candidate's proposed role and interest in working on the programme.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in the selection process/interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, and only by email. If a candidate does not hear from the University within 2 weeks after the last date of application, the application should be assumed unsuccessful. The University reserves the right to conduct interviews and not fill this position.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NUJS Programme Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one full-time contractual post of Programme Manager.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NUJS Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the University by midnight on 30 November 2026. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NUJS Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with an LL.B. degree, including the recipient of a 5-Year integrated B.A/B.Sc./BB.A./B.Com LL.B. (Hons.) degree, with proficiency in English and Hindi/Bengali and a minimum of five years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NUJS Programme Manager?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs 75,000/- per month during the first year of engagement.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the NUJS Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Send an updated resume and a Statement of Purpose (not exceeding 500 words) by email to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NUJS Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in the selection process/interview, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NUJS Programme Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a full-time contractual post for one year; any extension will be subject to the needs of the project and the availability of funds.

faq.question: Q8. Does the Programme Manager have to live in Kolkata?
faq.answer: Yes, the Programme Manager will be required to reside in Kolkata for the duration of the contract and to travel according to the needs of the project.

faq.question: Q9. Will NUJS pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the University is unable to cover the costs of attending interviews.

faq.question: Q10. How will I know if my application has not been shortlisted?
faq.answer: If you do not hear from the University within 2 weeks after the last date of application, the notice asks you to assume that your application has not succeeded.
